committee.sub: Morning brief · Saturday 10 October 2026 · the committee’s read on the 7am numbers

items.text: Spend held near $144 across 23 clicks this week at $6.26 CPC, matching the test's roughly $6 estimate, and the landing-page test still shows 14 raw paid clicks since 6 Oct with zero qualified enquiries.

CTR eased to 2.4% from 2.8% even as impressions grew to 976, impression share sits at only 10%, and rank lost (72%) still runs well ahead of budget lost (22.6%), so the budget-stays-fixed rule is not in play yet.
The dedicated review page pulled 23 of the week's sessions and logged 3 ask_cta_click events but no review_cta_click, with raw paid clicks at 14 since the test started on 6 Oct.

AI Assistant sessions rose to 4 from 1, led by claude-check, while Direct fell to 18 from 29 and should not be read as organic demand; Organic Search is the only trustworthy unpaid signal this week at 17 sessions.

actions.text: Raw paid clicks on the landing-page test passed 10 (now 14 since 6 Oct). Review search terms and Clarity recordings now and log exclusions before the next batch.
Logo and image assets are still outstanding for the serving ad groups (Agency and Job Intake).
RSA descriptions on the non-Agency ads still claim 13.3 hours of admin per week and 99.6% success. Update them to current site stats.
